draft_elevation.note: RECONSTRUCTED by the draft rules, family row '(default)' overlaid with the frontage row: A background house with no named record and no register row: the brick family's hip over the sheet's printed storeys, every face closed, nothing read beyond the sheet. 3B with a 2B rear part: the rounded stone bay on its Indiana front stands as the draft's projecting bay, one of the row of nine the sheet draws from 2007 to 2027. Heights are the rules' starting values inside RECONSTRUCTION-RULES.md's ranges; bays, entrance side, chimneys and dormers are counts the family rules choose, and the seed 2809958896 only tints the fabric inside +-6 %.
